name: dashboard-analytics-operations-support
executionConcern: dashboard, analytics, operations, support, carts and maps operational control
objective: Close dashboard, analytics, operations, support, carts and maps operational control end to end without losing canonical ownership, authorization, readback or directly affected surface compatibility.
truthOwner: DSH owns operational order, dispatch, support and serviceability truth; Control Panel is an authorized operator surface and downstream apps read committed consequences.

tasks.objective: Close dashboard and analytics readback against canonical scoped data
tasks.currentProblem: Dashboard/KPI data can be misleading if scope, freshness or error/empty semantics differ from operational owners.
tasks.requiredChange: Use canonical DSH read models with explicit scope and non-ambiguous loading/error/empty/no-result states.
tasks.targetState: Dashboard and analytics agree with operational truth for the same authorized scope and time window.
tasks.action: Trace dashboard/analytics queries through BFF/backend; correct scope/freshness/error semantics; verify representative readbacks.
mustNotChange: Do not create parallel domain truth or client-trusted authorization context.
Do not broaden execution into repository areas without a proven Control Panel dependency.
Do not weaken audit, idempotency, conflict or canonical-readback guarantees to make the UI appear successful.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard and analytics agree with operational truth for the same authorized scope and time window.
Forbidden/wrong-scope and dependency/error states fail explicitly rather than fabricating success.
State-changing actions are verified by canonical readback and directly affected surfaces where applicable.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving audit/data evidence; never restore parallel truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U002 implementation commit after owner correction, affected-consumer migration, cleanup and linked checks.

tasks.objective: Close operations, support, cart and map intervention journeys

tasks.targetState: Operations/support actions are safe under retries/concurrency/response loss and downstream surfaces converge on committed DSH truth.
